summary:
A 15-wide, 2-storey rough-stone farmhouse (x1..15, z11..19) with a steep red-tile roof, brick chimney (top y14), warped-green shuttered windows and a dark-oak lean-to porch on its east side. Beside it, through a lantern-lit gate on the porch axis, lies a walled symmetrical potager (x20..38, z4..32): four timber-edged raised beds with wheat/carrot/potato/beetroot rows, gravel+brick paths crossing at a roofed well, rose arches, espaliered fruit trees, a glasshouse, cold frame and tool shed.
Build as 6 parts (shell, porch+openings, potager, features, interior, grounds). vocab.mjs holds the layout, an OPENINGS table and tested helpers; the roof is a make.sh `mcd roof` cottage-preset step.

farmhouse shell: Built parts/shell.mjs: stone walls on the x1..15 z11..19 ring (cobble plinth, wallBlock stone, stone-brick quoins), jambs and lintels for the house-wall openings, spruce ground floor, oak upper floor with stairwell open, x=9 partition, and the brick chimney breast with the hearth niche unset.
make.sh finished and saved a whole build.nbt; the shell line reads "499 placed" with no REFUSED or OFF-PALETTE. mcd check shows 0 floating and 0 unsupported blocks. The front and isometric renders read as a stone house with a red roof and chimney.
Ticked plan.md item 1 and elements.md E1, E2, E4, E5, E31; added a P1 note to plan.md.
polish: Upper windows (y=7, h=1) have jambs but no lintel: the lintel would sit at y=8 in the roof zone, so it was skipped. The porch/features parts should not try to add it.
Shell frames only house-wall openings; the greenhouse door (25,1,27) and shed door (32,1,29) in OPENINGS are not framed by P1 and belong to the features part.
The front-elevation render is small; the quoins and door position read only at close range. Worth a close look once the porch and door are in.

summary: porch and openings: parts/porch.mjs built: all 8 house windows (shutters, sills; east ones without sill) and both doors, front stoop with two lamps, dark-oak/spruce lean-to porch with roof stopping at y=7, lanterns, cobblestone step, chairs, barrel, pot. make.sh gives a whole build.nbt; my line is porch+openings:191 with no REFUSED or OFF-PALETTE; mcd check shows 0 floating blocks. Front and porch close-ups read as shuttered stone with a timber lean-to.
polish: Pot is potted_poppy, not the spec's potted_red_tulip (not in palette.json). Rails skip (16,2,12) and (16,2,18), which hold the barrel and pot. East windows have no sill because the porch seat occupies that cell.
P6 collision: the woodpile (x3..7, z20, y1..3) overlaps the back-window sill (4,2,20) and shutters at (3|5|7,3..4,20). P6 must skip those cells; logged in plan.md Notes.
make.sh roof step reports '12 refused (protected/keep)' on the house roof. Not investigated; the porch is at y<=7 so the roof zone (y>=8) does not touch it.
mcd check lists 9 orphans: window sills and shutters that are cantilevered off the wall. Left as designed.

summary:
potager walls, paths, beds, well: parts/potager.mjs builds the walled potager: gravel paths with brick centre lines and plaza, rough-stone wall with stone-brick cap, gate pillars/beam/oak gate with lanterns, four planted beds (NW/NE/SW/SE) with crop rows and water pools, and the well at (29,15). make.sh passes with 972 placed, no refusals, no off-palette blocks; the render shows the walled garden, striped beds and the well at the crossing.
Well roof uses a local well() with texture:false and edges:false, because vocab's well() emitted off-palette mud_brick_stairs and birch_trapdoor; noted in plan.md Notes.
E9–E14 ticked in elements.md and part 3 ticked in plan.md.
polish: The gate and its lanterns were built per spec but not zoomed in the render, so their look is unchecked.
mcd check flags the well's cauldron (29,2,15) as an orphan: it hangs on the chain, as the spec draws the bucket. Left as is.
vocab.mjs well() still uses the off-palette roof path; part 4 or later must not call it unchanged. Documented in plan.md Notes.

summary:
garden features: parts/features.mjs builds the rose arches, 8 espaliers, glasshouse with bench and pots, cold frame, tool shed, sundial, urn, 8 lamp posts and the z=5 flower edging: 507 cells, 0 refused, 0 off-palette.
make.sh produced a whole build.nbt (17:38), `mcd check` reports 0 floating blocks, and the gate and yard close-up renders show the arches, trained trees, glasshouse and shed reading as intended.
Ticked plan.md item 4 and elements E14b, E15, E16, E17, E18, E19, E8b; a P4 note in plan.md records the deviations below.
polish: Shed interior fit: the shed walls own x32/36, so the interior is 3x2 (x33..35, z29..30). It holds crafting table, barrel, chest, grindstone, lantern and hay; the second barrel and the shed composter moved to (37,1,28) outside the east wall.
Glasshouse bench has 3 pots (fern, azalea, red tulip) plus a lantern; the oxeye daisy pot is dropped because the 4-cell bench has no free cell.
vocab toolShed() picks birch fascia, which gives off-palette birch_trapdoor. features.mjs has a local shed() with spruce fascia instead. vocab.mjs was not edited.

summary:
interior: Interior part built in parts/interior.mjs (64 blocks, no refusals, no off-palette): oak stair with rails and barrels, parlour table+6 chairs+bookshelves+chest+fern+lantern, kitchen campfire hearth with step, counter, cauldron, dining table+5 chairs, bedrooms with red/white and blue beds, carpets, barrels, lanterns.
make.sh produced a whole build.nbt; mcd check reports 0 floating and 0 unsupported blocks; parlour, kitchen, bedroom and stair renders read as intended.
Ticked plan.md item 5 and elements E20-E25 in this part's copy.

grounds: parts/grounds.mjs built: front gravel path with brick centre, oak picket fence with gate at (8,1,1), rose/lilac/peony/cornflower/poppy/allium beds, oak-leaf hedge, four lamps, footpath, five apple trees plus azalea and rear trees (roof-zone forbid), oak woodpile, west hedgerow.
Gate has fence posts at (7,1,1) and (9,1,1) rather than the spec's open gap (noted in plan.md Notes).
make.sh produced a whole build.nbt: grounds placed 1099 cells, 0 refused, 0 off-palette; street render reads right. E26-E30 and plan item 6 ticked.
polish: Orchard and back trees leave about 9 orphan leaf/log blocks where canopies touch (mcd check); natural tree shape, not floating, so left as is.
Porch door lamps (6,1,10),(10,1,10) and the stoop step (8,1,10) belong to parts/porch.mjs, not grounds; the path ends at the stoop without building it.
The gate sits in a fence line with posts either side, not in a 3-wide open gap; change in grounds.mjs if the owner wants the open gap.
